lessons.overview: Understanding tuples, immutable data structures, and the difference between tuples and lists.

lessons.title: Functions
lessons.overview: Defining and calling functions to organize code and perform specific tasks.

lessons.title: Return Statement

lessons.title: Comments

lessons.title: Building a Multiple Choice Quiz

bulletPoints: Core concept: Building a Multiple Choice Quiz

lessons.title: Object Functions
lessons.overview: Defining and using functions within classes to modify or get information about objects.

lessons.title: Inheritance

lessons.title: Python Interpreter
lessons.overview: Using the Python interpreter (command prompt/terminal) for quick code execution.

lessons.title: Introduction
lessons.overview: Course overview and introduction to SQL and RDBMS.

lessons.title: MySQL Mac Installation
lessons.overview: Step-by-step guide to installing MySQL Server and PopSQL on a Mac.

lessons.title: Creating Tables
lessons.overview: Using the CREATE TABLE statement and defining column data types in SQL.

lessons.title: Inserting Data
lessons.overview: Using the INSERT INTO statement to add rows of data into a database table.

lessons.title: Constraints
lessons.overview: Applying table constraints like NOT NULL, UNIQUE, DEFAULT, and AUTO_INCREMENT.

lessons.title: Update & Delete
lessons.overview: Modifying existing data using UPDATE and removing data using DELETE statements.

lessons.title: Basic Queries
lessons.overview: Writing fundamental SELECT statements to retrieve and filter data.

lessons.title: Company Database Intro
lessons.overview: Introduction to a more complex company database schema used for advanced querying.

lessons.title: Creating Company Database
lessons.overview: Implementing the company database schema by creating multiple related tables.

lessons.title: Functions
lessons.overview: Using SQL aggregate functions like COUNT, AVG, SUM, and grouping data.

lessons.title: More Basic Queries
lessons.overview: Exploring more ways to write SELECT queries, using aliases (AS), and selecting distinct values.

lessons.title: What is a Database?
lessons.overview: Understanding what databases are, types of databases, and CRUD operations.
bulletPoints: Core concept: What is a Database?

lessons.title: Wildcards
lessons.overview: Using the LIKE keyword and wildcards (% and _) to match string patterns.

lessons.title: Union
lessons.overview: Combining the result sets of two or more SELECT statements using UNION.

lessons.title: Joins
lessons.overview: Using INNER, LEFT, and RIGHT JOINs to combine rows from multiple tables based on related columns.

lessons.title: Nested Queries
lessons.overview: Writing queries within queries to use the result of one SELECT statement to filter another.

lessons.title: On Delete
lessons.overview: Handling foreign key deletions using ON DELETE SET NULL and ON DELETE CASCADE.

lessons.title: Triggers
lessons.overview: Creating triggers to automatically execute SQL code when a specific event occurs on a table.

lessons.overview: Introduction to Entity-Relationship (ER) Diagrams, entities, attributes, and relationships.

bulletPoints: Core concept: Converting ER Diagrams to Schemas

lessons.title: Tables & Keys
lessons.overview: Core concepts of relational databases including rows, columns, primary keys, and foreign keys.

lessons.overview: Introduction to Structured Query Language (SQL) and its various components (DDL, DML, DQL, DCL).
